boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UNC destinations for studying, gathering, art, science, and outdoor time, supported by current university and cultural-institution sources.

cards.title: Davis Library
cards.subtitle: Main campus library · study space
cards.notes: Start with the building directory, then choose a seat or reserve a study room when your work needs a shared table and fewer interruptions.
cards.short_summary: A large campus library with general study seating and reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC identifies Davis Library as a campus library open to everyone and describes campus libraries as providing study spaces for different preferences.
cards.access_notes: Check University Libraries hours and room-reservation information before going.

cards.title: House Undergraduate Library
cards.subtitle: North Campus · study space
cards.notes: Use the House Undergraduate Library as a change-of-scene study stop; check its current hours before planning a longer session.
cards.short_summary: An undergraduate-focused library included among UNC’s welcoming campus libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC lists the House Undergraduate Library among campus libraries open to everyone and states that the library system offers study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Confirm building hours and any access updates through University Libraries.

cards.title: Wilson Special Collections Library
cards.subtitle: North Campus · special collections
cards.notes: Pair a study visit with a look at current special-collections offerings, and ask staff about using collection materials for class research.
cards.short_summary: A special-collections library that is part of UNC’s campus library network.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC lists the Wilson Special Collections Library among campus libraries open to everyone and describes library spaces and research expertise.
cards.access_notes: Collection use and reading-room procedures may differ from general library spaces.

cards.title: Health Sciences Library
cards.subtitle: Health Sciences campus · study space
cards.notes: Use this library when health-related coursework needs a focused work setting; review current building hours and service details before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A named UNC campus library supporting study and research.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC lists the Health Sciences Library among campus libraries open to everyone and states that campus libraries provide study spaces and research expertise.
cards.access_notes: Check the Health Sciences Library’s current access and hours information.

cards.title: Kenan Science Library
cards.subtitle: Science campus · subject library
cards.notes: Bring science-course questions or reading here, then use the library’s listed services and spaces to structure a focused work block.
cards.short_summary: A subject-specific UNC library for science-oriented study and research.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC states that subject-specific branch libraries are open to everyone and that campus libraries offer study spaces and research expertise.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current Kenan Science Library schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Carolina Union
cards.subtitle: 209 South Road · student union
cards.notes: Meet a classmate, use the building map to orient yourself, or settle in to study, eat, or relax during posted Union hours.
cards.short_summary: UNC’s student union combines gathering space, services, student involvement, and events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carolina Union invites visitors to study, eat, or relax there and provides programs, services, facilities, student-organization support, and reservable space.
cards.access_notes: The Union posts building hours; some services, food vendors, and reservable spaces have separate schedules or requirements.

cards.title: Coker Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Cameron Avenue and Raleigh Street · outdoor garden
cards.notes: Take the walking paths past trees and seasonal plantings, pause on an open lawn or bench, and avoid the arbor path while its renovation continues.
cards.short_summary: A five-acre UNC garden with walking paths, lawns, benches, and seasonal plant displays.
cards.evidence_claim: The North Carolina Botanical Garden describes Coker Arboretum as a five-acre UNC-campus garden with walking paths, lawns, benches, and dawn-to-dusk daily access.
cards.access_notes: Open dawn to dusk, 365 days a year. The arbor path along Cameron Avenue is closed for renovation, with reopening expected after July 2026 work.

cards.title: Forest Theater
cards.subtitle: Battle Park · outdoor performance venue
cards.notes: Walk through Battle Park to see the stone seating and natural bowl, then check event organizers before attending a scheduled performance or gathering.
cards.short_summary: An open-air UNC performance space with a long connection to Carolina Playmakers.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC A to Z identifies Forest Theater as an outdoor performance space in Battle Park that remains in use for performances and other gatherings.
cards.access_notes: Public events and venue use vary; follow event-specific entry and ticket instructions.

cards.title: Ackland Art Museum
cards.subtitle: 101 S. Columbia Street · campus-adjacent museum
cards.notes: Drop in to view the galleries, use the gallery map to pace your visit, and check the calendar for current programs or extended Second Friday hours.
cards.short_summary: UNC’s art museum offers free gallery admission near Franklin Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ackland Art Museum states that admission is always free and provides current visiting hours, gallery maps, exhibitions, and public programming.
cards.source_title: Visit the Ackland Art Museum at UNC-Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free. Current hours are Wednesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m., Sunday 1–5 p.m.; Second Friday is open until 9 p.m.

cards.title: Morehead Planetarium and Science Center
cards.subtitle: 250 E. Franklin Street · UNC-Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Check the day’s science programs and exhibits before you go, then allow time to navigate the UNC-owned parking lot or arrive by transit.
cards.short_summary: A campus science center with public programs and planetarium shows.
cards.evidence_claim: Morehead Planetarium and Science Center identifies its location on UNC-Chapel Hill’s campus, lists public hours, and publishes science programming and planetarium shows.
cards.access_notes: The center posts current hours and program schedules online; individual planetarium shows or events may have separate ticket requirements.
